construction: Repeat the supplied P4mm BaTiO3 5-atom basis 2x2x2. In the first translated cell (i=0,j=0,k=0), replace Ba by Zn and Ti by Co; retain all other atoms. Fractional basis: Ba(0,0,0), Ti(0.5,0.5,0.5), O(0.5,0.5,0), O(0.5,0,0.5), O(0,0.5,0.5). This is an initialization; relaxation is required.
oxidation_model: formal Zn2+ for Ba2+ and Co4+ for Ti4+; no oxygen vacancies
